channel.title: SciML Weekly
channel.description: A weekly digest of new research in scientific machine learning, statistical learning, and AI for fluid dynamics and physics. Each issue is written to be readable without a PhD in the subfield, and every claim links to its source.

item.title: Rollouts that stay stable, hourly AI weather, and small models that win
item.description: This issue covers September 2026: WeatherNext 3 moves AI weather forecasting to hourly updates, two papers attack error build-up in long neural-PDE rollouts, and in both a CFD challenge and a distillation study, much smaller models beat big ones.
